<thought>Without the exact target molecule SMILES, I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that correspond to the Still‑Gennari HWE transformation by specifying the functional groups formed (alkene and carboxylic ester) and broken (phosphonate and alkyne). The first matching template should be the one that, when applied to the target molecule, reproduces the described reaction. I will then retrieve its mapped reaction SMILES and template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=CC(=O)O", 
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene", "carboxylic_ester"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["phosphonate", "alkyne"],
    "limit": 1
}</action_input>
